subject: Stakeholder mapping and next steps — Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Conway <lisa@horizonfinance.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Stakeholder mapping and next steps — Redwood evaluation

Hi Lisa,

Thanks again for the time this morning — great conversation and appreciate the transparency on current pain around latency for your internal analytics workloads and the throughput spikes during month-end close. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: Redwood hosted + dedicated options look like the best fit for pilot (cost predictability for month-end bursts, private deployment for sensitive PII).
- Action items I/O:
  1) Could you share a stakeholder map or org chart (who the economic buyer is, primary technical reviewers, security/legal contacts, procurement point of contact)?
  2) What are the formal procurement steps (RFP/PO/contract owner)? Any standard SLAs or insurance requirements?
  3) Decision criteria & timeline — when would you expect a pilot to start and who signs off?

We'd like to get a short intro arranged between your CISO/security lead and our security engineer (Rishi) to run through our SOC 2 controls, KMS integration, and data flow. Would you be able to loop in the appropriate stakeholder(s), or share names/emails and a quick org chart?

Proposed next meeting: 30-min security/arch deep-dive the week of Mar 8th — Rishi is flexible Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Attachments: happy to send a short Redwood Security Summary and the standard vendor questionnaire in advance — will attach once I have the right contacts.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Lisa Conway <lisa@horizonfinance.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping and next steps — Redwood evaluation

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the helpful suggested agenda. Quick notes below and attached is an org chart snapshot.

- Economic buyer: Mark Benson (CISO) — he owns vendor security sign-off and will be involved in final purchase decisions for infra/security-sensitive purchases.
- Technical reviewers: Myself (Head of Data Platform), plus two SREs (Olivia Park and Daniel Ruiz)
- Security/legal: Mark Benson (CISO), legal@horizonfinance.com (for contract review)
- Procurement: procurement@horizonfinance.com — standard vendor onboarding includes a security questionnaire and our PO/contracting cadence.
- Timeline: We are targeting a pilot decision by end of Q2; procurement lead time ~4–6 weeks after pilot sign-off but we can parallelize questionnaire/insurance.

I attached a lightweight org chart (Horizon_Org_Chart_v1.pdf). I'll loop Mark and procurement in on the next message so you can schedule a brief security call.

Cheers,
Lisa Conway
Head of Data Platform, Horizon Finance
lisa@horizonfinance.com
